en.quote: “Over the next decade, we must at least double the country’s GDP.”
en.head: The target was missed by the 2013 deadline; in 2015 Peskov called it “effectively achieved,” citing Kudrin’s estimate of roughly 94% growth in 2000–2014.
en.body: In March 2015, Peskov said the GDP-doubling target had effectively been achieved. Kudrin said the country had come close over 15 years, after growth in 2000–2007. The result depends on the baseline: those estimates start in 2000, while the pledge was made in 2003.

notes: Distinguish the original ten-year deadline from later claims using a 2000 baseline.
